This file guides Claude Code for this repository.

**CRITICAL**: This project uses **UV** for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.

Commands:
```sh
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
make dev
make verify
make test
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint
make format
make doctor
make build-plugin
make sync-plugin-repo
make clean
```

**⚠️ IMPORTANT**: The `.claude-plugin/` directory and TypeScript plugin system described in older docs **DO NOT EXIST** in v4.1.9. This is planned for v5.0 (see [issue #419](https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework/issues/419)).

v4.1.9 is a Python package with slash commands. Key paths: `settings.json`, `commands/`, `src/superclaude/` (`pytest_plugin.py`, `pm_agent/`, `execution/`, `cli/`), `tests/`, `scripts/`, `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`. `plugins/superclaude/` is future, NOT ACTIVE. Package/build/CLI: `superclaude`/hatchling/`superclaude`; pytest auto-loads `superclaude`. Install: `pipx install superclaude && superclaude install`; commands install to `~/.claude/commands/`.

Fixtures: `confidence_checker`, `self_check_protocol`, `reflexion_pattern`, `token_budget`, `pm_context`. Markers: `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.unit`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.integration`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.confidence_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.self_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.reflexion`.

ConfidenceChecker: ≥90% required, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions. SelfCheckProtocol validates post-implementation with evidence; no speculation—verify with tests/docs. ReflexionPattern records errors and matches patterns across sessions. Use **Wave → Checkpoint → Wave**.

**Never guess** - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation. Check confidence BEFORE starting: ≥90% proceed, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions. Prefer MCP tools over speculation. Gateway: **airis-mcp-gateway**.

Branches: `master` ← `integration` ← `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`.
1. Create branch from `integration`: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature`
2. Develop with tests: `uv run pytest`
3. Commit: `git commit -m "feat: description"` (conventional commits)
4. Merge to `integration` → validate → merge to `master`

**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
```sh
cd ~/github/SuperClaude_Framework
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent
git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration
```

Consult `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`, and `docs/`. Token budgets: simple 200, medium 1,000, complex 2,500.

Setup:
```sh
pipx install superclaude
git clone https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework.git
cd SuperClaude_Framework
```

❌ `.claude-plugin/` directory auto-detection
❌ `/plugin marketplace add` commands
❌ `/plugin install superclaude`
❌ `make build-plugin` (planned but not functional)
❌ Project-loca
